title: Uranium Age
description: Adds uranium and reactors to the game
body:
This is the second mod I have published.

# **Uranium Age**
## What is it?
  _Uraium Age_ is a mod that adds _uranium_ to the game!

## Why do I need this mod?
  _Uranium Age_ adds _uranium_ to the game; of course you can't say no to _uranium_ in **Minecraft**. Can you?

## A screenshot of the blocks this mod adds.
![A screenshot of the blocks this mod adds.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0db262b55fd9c2333c9fb33e432d2d2df8da7b33.png)

## How does this mod affect my game?
   Well, I am glad you asked. This mod adds _uranium,_ of course, to the game.
 - _Uranium_ is radioactive, so it can hurt players and alive entities, like sheep. 
 - _Uranium_ is radioactive, so it can be used to perform fission reactions, which produce a lot of heat. Maybe you can extract that heat to fuel your furnaces???
 - Can you use _Uranium_ to make traps? Maybe :) . 

## How do the things in this mod work?
  I don't want to spoil this for the people who like to not read instructions, so I made it a spoiler.
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>
  
### **Radioactivity:**
  There are 4 forms of _uranium_ in the game, each with its own radiation range, with the lowest range being on _Uranium_ ore, and the highest range being on _Uranium_ block.
  
  This radiation can be blocked by placing Lead Blocks around it, just like you can do with the sculk sensor. Place a lead block on one of the faces of the _Uranium_ block in question, and it will block all radiation from going in that direction.

### **Armor:**
  As you saw in the screenshot, there is an armor set in the mod. It's made of Lead, and a full set of it can be used to block radiation, making you not take damage from any and all _Uranium_ blocks. But this armor is not very strong, with armor levels between iron and copper but more towards the iron side.

### **Reactors:**
  As you say in the screenshot that, there was a reactor there. Well, that is not the only reactor that this mod adds, as there also exist portable reactors.

  The Reactor Block can be placed down and fuel any furnace, blast furnace, and smoker on top of it, but only when it's running. The reactor requires a boron rod, a boron ingot, and either a _Uranium_ ingot or a _Uranium_ block, and both the ingot and the block last for a long time. **AND DO NOT REMOVE THE BORON INGOT UNTIL THE REACTOR SHUTS OFF!**

  The portable reactors, specifically the _portable uranium reactor_ and the _portable uranium block reactor_, both can be placed in the fuel slot of the furnace, and that powers the furnace until the reactor runs out of heat, so it will not get used up until it runs out of _uranium_ fuel.

  Ingot fuel does not last as long as Block fuel, but ingots are cheaper then blocks so use at your own risk.

  Building a reactor requires:
- A core with an exception to the Reactor Block which does not need a pre-made core.
- A boiler.
- A body (of course).
- And specifically for the Reactor Block it requires a Reactor Controls.

### **Ores:**
  _Uranium_, Boron, and Lead can be found in caves in their ore forms, both in stone and deepslate layers, but spawn more in the deepslate layer, and can be mined with an Iron, Diamond, or Netherite pickaxe.

  Be careful while you are moving through caves; you might not know when you get close to _Uranium_ ore and get hit with radiation!

</details>
